positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Ocient is designing a distributed database, optimized for use on NVMe solid state drives. In a team of two, we designed and wrote a utility which simulates faulty hardware in order to test how robust the Ocient database is to hardware failures. I also wrote unit tests for one of the stages of the Ocient command compiler pipeline.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked on Gwydion's main project, Arthea. Arthea is a virtual reality application which allows researchers and educators to collaboratively view and manipulate 3D models. In a team of two, implemented we the ability to save the state of a room, implemented a tool to snap two
3D models together, and reimplemented the majority of the UI. We also refactored large portions of the codebase.

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: Sage Corps is a global entrepreneurship program that sends top college students (Fellows) to study and intern abroad with tech startups. Fellows spend their days alongside CEOs, CTOs, and COOs tackling real problems and building impactful solutions. After work, Fellows attend professional events to learn additional skills and to develop a global network. Finally, Fellows connect with a community of alumni and the Sage Network, who help with career advice and opportunities.
